data.title: 莲华 · 大正洋风文库的高梯秘卷
data.description: 大正时期高耸入云的红木藏书阁内，彩绘玻璃窗将斜阳切成五彩光斑。莲华身穿暗紫细纹袴装驻足在木梯高处，手中取下一卷古卷，居高临下露出傲然轻笑。
data.location: towering multi-story Taisho-era library with mahogany book stacks and stained glass arched windows
data.action: standing high on wooden library ladder, pulling an ancient leatherbound tome from shelf, looking down with a superior mocking smirk
data.lighting: 高窗彩绘玻璃斑斓夕阳斜射
data.promptProse: Renge stands high on a rolling library ladder in a Taisho study pulling a rare volume, glancing down with a haughty, knowing smirk.
data.animaCaption: Stained glass window patterns project jewel tones across her hakama as she looks down.
